title: AI Engineer
desc:
ABOUT TERRANOVA

Terranova is a hard-tech company developing innovative systems to reshape the physical world. We combine mechanical engineering, robotics, automation, and real-world field operations to tackle complex engineering challenges.

We're looking for an AI Engineer to help us build smarter, more efficient ways of working across our engineering, manufacturing, and field operations.




ABOUT THE ROLE

As an AI Engineer at Terranova, you'll develop practical AI-powered tools, software, and analytical models that improve how our team designs, builds, tests, and operates complex machinery.

This is a highly hands-on role focused on solving real engineering and operational problems. You'll work closely with mechanical, electrical, software, and field engineers to identify inefficiencies, automate repetitive workflows, and turn operational data into actionable insights.

We're looking for someone who can independently identify opportunities, rapidly prototype solutions, and deploy tools that make a measurable difference in how the company operates.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

AI Tools & Workflow Automation

 - Design and build internal AI-powered tools that streamline engineering, manufacturing, and operational workflows.

 - Identify repetitive, manual, or cumbersome processes and develop software solutions to automate them.

 - Integrate AI tools with existing engineering software, databases, documentation, and operational systems.

 - Build internal applications that help engineers and operators access information, make decisions, and complete tasks more efficiently.

Data Analysis & Process Optimization

 - Develop systems to collect, track, and analyze metrics across shop operations, equipment performance, and field activities.

 - Analyze field injection data, including flow rates, pressures, material consumption, ground uplift, and operational efficiency.

 - Build dashboards, reporting tools, and data pipelines to visualize performance and identify opportunities for improvement.

 - Help quantify engineering and manufacturing processes to establish benchmarks, monitor performance, and reduce inefficiencies.

 - Develop models to predict operational outcomes, improve process parameters, and support engineering decisions.

Modeling & Applied AI

 - Build and deploy machine learning, statistical, and predictive models for engineering applications.

 - Use LLMs, AI agents, and other emerging technologies to automate complex workflows and improve internal productivity.

 - Develop tools for analyzing experimental results, identifying trends, and optimizing system performance.

 - Explore new applications of AI across robotics, manufacturing, equipment monitoring, and field operations.

Cross-Functional Engineering

 - Work directly with engineers, technicians, and operators to understand challenges and develop practical solutions.

 - Take projects from problem identification through prototyping, implementation, and iteration.

 - Build lightweight, maintainable tools that can be deployed quickly and improved based on real-world feedback.

 - Proactively identify opportunities where software, data, or AI can improve the company's efficiency and capabilities.


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - Strong proficiency in Python and experience building software tools, automation scripts, and data-processing pipelines.

 - Experience working with LLM APIs, AI agents, machine learning frameworks, or applied AI systems.

 - Ability to build end-to-end applications, from data ingestion and backend logic to simple user interfaces.

 - Strong data analysis skills, including SQL, Pandas, and statistical modeling.

 - Experience integrating APIs, databases, and third-party software platforms.

 - Comfortable working with messy, incomplete, or unstructured real-world data.

 - Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to independently take loosely defined problems and turn them into working solutions.

 - Interest in physical engineering systems, manufacturing, robotics, or industrial operations.

 - Ability to work closely with multidisciplinary teams and communicate technical concepts clearly.


NICE TO HAVE

 - Experience with industrial automation, PLCs, sensors, or equipment telemetry.

 - Familiarity with mechanical engineering, fluid systems, hydraulics, or manufacturing processes.

 - Experience with time-series data, predictive modeling, or optimization algorithms.

 - Experience developing computer vision applications for industrial monitoring or quality control.

 - Familiarity with CAD software, engineering simulations, or engineering data pipelines.

 - Experience deploying internal tools using modern web frameworks and cloud services.


WHY TERRANOVA?

At Terranova, you'll have the opportunity to apply AI to real-world engineering problems rather than building software in isolation. Your work will directly influence how physical systems are designed, manufactured, tested, and operated.

You'll have significant ownership over projects, the freedom to experiment with new technologies, and the ability to see your solutions implemented in the shop and in the field.

We're looking for a builder who enjoys moving quickly, solving ambiguous problems, and using AI and software to make complex engineering operations more efficient.

title: Applied AI Engineer, Digital Natives
desc:
About the Team

OpenAI’s Applied AI Engineering team helps organizations turn frontier AI capabilities into safe, reliable, and high-impact production systems. We work with customer executives, product and engineering teams, security leaders, and transformation teams to identify valuable opportunities, accelerate technical implementation, and scale what works.

Enterprise deployments are defined by complexity rather than any one industry: existing architectures, diverse data environments, security and governance requirements, multiple stakeholder groups, and organization-wide change. We turn lessons from these deployments into better products and reusable patterns for customers everywhere.

About the Role

As an Applied AI Engineer, you will partner directly with Digital Native companies to design, build and deploy AI-powered products and systems. Working alongside customer product and engineering teams, you will take ideas from early experimentation through evaluation, production launch and scale, connecting technical decisions to user experience and measurable business impact.

You will write and debug code, build evaluation systems, resolve complex integrations, and guide decisions involving model behavior, reliability, latency, cost, safety, security, governance, and operational readiness. Success is measured by production systems, sustained adoption, and meaningful customer impact—not simply activity or successful demonstrations.

This is a rare opportunity to work on consequential real-world deployments at the frontier of AI while directly influencing how OpenAI’s products evolve.

This role is based in London. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees

In this role, you will:

 - Partner directly with Digital Native customers to identify high-value opportunities and translate them into technical architectures, implementation plans, evaluation strategies, and measurable success criteria.

 - Design, build, and deploy AI systems that solve important customer problems and produce measurable business outcomes.

 - Work hands-on in code to build prototypes, evaluation harnesses, reference implementations, integrations, and production accelerators.

 - Make sound technical decisions across models, agents, retrieval, tools, data, reliability, observability, latency, cost, safety, security, and governance.

 - Diagnose complex implementation challenges, reproduce failures, test hypotheses, and drive blockers toward resolution.

 - Help customers progress from promising prototypes to reliable production systems, sustained adoption, and scaled impact.

 - Partner closely with customer engineering teams and OpenAI Product, Research, Engineering, Security, and go-to-market teams, translating deployment experience into high-signal product feedback.

 - Create reusable architectures, tooling, playbooks, and technical guidance that accelerate future enterprise deployments.

You’ll thrive in this role if you:

 - Have a demonstrated track record of designing, building, and delivering AI or machine-learning systems in enterprise environments, including taking systems from prototype to production. Relevant backgrounds may include applied AI or ML engineering, forward-deployed engineering, software engineering, customer engineering, solutions architecture, or technical consulting.

 - Can point to substantial personal contributions in code, architecture, evaluation, debugging, or production engineering—not only program or stakeholder management.

 - Are highly proficient in Python and comfortable working across an AI application stack; experience with JavaScript, TypeScript, or another relevant language is valuable.

 - Understand how to evaluate AI systems systematically using representative data, graders, production signals, and human judgment.

 - Have navigated enterprise production requirements such as integrations, reliability, observability, security, privacy, data governance, performance, and cost.

 - Can connect technical decisions to customer workflows, adoption, and measurable business outcomes.

 - Communicate with clarity and credibility across hands-on engineers, technical leaders, security teams, product leaders, and executives.

 - Bring high agency, strong technical judgment, and end-to-end ownership in ambiguous environments.

 - Learn quickly, challenge assumptions constructively, and collaborate with humility; experience in a particular industry or with OpenAI products is not required.



About OpenAI

OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity.
